findings.description: T&T Supermarket signed a lease in March 2025 for the 50,000-square-foot space at 2675 Geary Blvd. in City Center, empty nearly a decade, and opens its first San Francisco store there Nov. 5. Dated to the announcement, 6 October; opening is a future date.
